data.camera: cowboy shot, standing on the royal capital castle roof and looking toward the horizon
data.description: 【三笠 · 自由之翼下】王都城堡的屋顶上，三笠迎着夕阳而立，绿色披风与红围巾同时被风托起，她微微抬头望向墙外的方向——「总有一天，我们要走出这些墙。」
data.promptProse: Mikasa watches beyond the walls from the castle roof, wind lifting her cape and red scarf; low sunlight rims her profile.
data.title: 三笠 · 自由之翼下
data.animaCaption: Wind lifts her cape and scarf above the castle roof.
